_comment: The DEFAULT matching scheme. Record-based string rules only — no model judgment. Students replace this file with their own scheme and document it in CHANGE-BRIEF.md. A TA must be able to apply it by hand to one posting.
_how_to_read: title: a résumé experience title (parentheses stripped) appears whole in the posting title.
title_partial: every word (>3 letters) of the résumé title appears in the posting title when the title has two or fewer such words; all but one when it has more.
skill: a résumé skill string appears as a whole phrase in the posting title or content; capped at max_skill_hits.
skill_unshipped: same, for skills.familiar_with_not_shipped — honest, so weighted low.
skill_any: added once if any skill hit at all. A job with zero skill hits is never relevant, whatever the score.
degree: a degree abbreviation from education[].degree (MS, PhD, MBA, BS…) appears in the content.
location: posting location contains the résumé city, or the word remote. location_miss otherwise (soft) — set location_mode to hard to make it a gate.
exclude_title_patterns: regexes that skip a posting outright, before scoring.
